recent.text: “How ‘bout three on the night?” 🤯 On this day in 2011, Albert Pujols became the third player in MLB history to homer three times in a World Series game as he led the Cardinals to a 16-7 victory over the Texas Rangers in Game 3. https://t.co/IyyOezIB2r
